rationale: This is the right next pre-GNN action after the negative v20.90 CPU diagnostic: expand heldout eval difficulty using new rows rather than salvaging training. The packet is source-safe, bounded to four candidates across two heldout rows, and success allows either a new strict same-target row or a useful non-strict contrast label, so it has more ways to pay off than a strict-only replay. Probability is moderated by local-context and namespace risk for isoSpec/density signatures, plus the chance that failed candidates are uninformative rather than usable hard negatives.
